**Tesla Model S – Approximate Price in India**

| Item | Details |
|------|---------|
| **Base Model (Long‑Range)** | Roughly **₹1.5 crore** (≈ ₹15 million) |
| **Performance Model** | Roughly **₹1.7 crore** (≈ ₹17 million) |
| **Estimated Total Cost of Ownership (incl. taxes, duties, insurance, charging infrastructure)** | **₹1.8–2.0 crore** |

> **Key Points**  
> • Tesla has not officially launched in India yet, so the above figures are estimates based on the U.S. price ($90k–$100k) plus Indian import duties (≈ 35 % on the vehicle, 18 % GST, and additional taxes).  
> • Prices can vary depending on the exact configuration, local dealer mark‑ups, and any future changes in duty rates or Tesla’s pricing strategy.  
> • If you’re interested in buying a used Model S from abroad, you’ll need to factor in shipping, customs clearance, and potential import taxes, which can add 10–20 % to the purchase price.  

**Bottom Line:** Expect a Tesla Model S to cost somewhere in the **₹1.5–2.0 crore** range in India, but keep an eye on official announcements for the most accurate pricing.
